data.aggregate.yaml:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

api:
  openapi: ../specs/openai-chat.yaml
  operationId: createChatCompletion
components:
  preprocessor:
    openapi: ../specs/preprocessor.yaml
    baseUrl: http://dynamo-preprocessor:50051
  selector:
    openapi: ../specs/selector.yaml
    baseUrl: http://dynamo-selector:50051
  workers:
    openapi: ../specs/chat-worker.yaml
    discovery: {group: aggregate}
steps:
  - id: prepare
    call:
      component: preprocessor
      operationId: prepare
      timeoutMs: 10000
      input:
        item_id: "$.request.id"
        openai_request_json: "$.request.body"
        preserve_omitted_max_tokens: false
        lora_name: ""
        deadline_unix_ms: 0
        packed_tokens_only: true
      output:
        normalized_request: "$.response.normalized_openai_request_json"
        backend_request: "$.response.backend_request_json"
        selector_request: "$.response.selector_request_json"
        token_ids_le: "$.response.token_ids_le"
      batch: {maxSize: 32, lingerUs: 100}
  - id: select
    call:
      component: selector
      operationId: select
      timeoutMs: 2000
      input:
        item_id: "$.request.id"
        payload_json: "$.vars.selector_request"
        token_ids_le: "$.vars.token_ids_le"
        deadline_unix_ms: 0
      output:
        worker_endpoint: "$.response.payload_json.endpoint"
  - id: generate
    call:
      component: workers
      operationId: generate
      target: "$.vars.worker_endpoint"
      timeoutMs: 120000
      input:
        request_id: "$.request.id"
        backend_request_json: "$.vars.backend_request"
        normalized_openai_request_json: "$.vars.normalized_request"
        token_ids_le: "$.vars.token_ids_le"
        deadline_unix_ms: 0
      stream: {}
      respond: true
data.selector.yaml:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

openapi: 3.0.3
info: {title: Dynamo canonical selector facade, version: "1.0"}
paths:
  /select:
    post:
      operationId: select
      x-grpc: {service: dynamo.components.v1.Selector, method: Select}
      x-grpc-json-bytes: true
      x-batch:
        intoField: items
        responseField: items
        operationId: selectBatch
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [item_id, payload_json]
              properties:
                item_id: {type: string}
                payload_json: {type: object}
                token_ids: {type: array, items: {type: integer}}
                token_ids_le: {type: string}
                deadline_unix_ms: {type: integer}
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: &result
                type: object
                properties:
                  item_id: {type: string}
                  payload_json: {type: object}
                  error: {type: object}
  /select_batch:
    post:
      operationId: selectBatch
      x-grpc: {service: dynamo.components.v1.Selector, method: SelectBatch}
      x-grpc-json-bytes: true
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [items]
              properties:
                items: {type: array, items: {type: object}}
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [items]
                properties:
                  items: {type: array, items: *result}

data.envoy.yaml:
admin: {address: {socket_address: {address: 0.0.0.0, port_value: 9901}}}
static_resources:
  listeners:
    - name: inference
      address: {socket_address: {address: 0.0.0.0, port_value: 8080}}
      filter_chains:
        - filters:
            - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
              typed_config:
                "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
                stat_prefix: inference
                request_timeout: 120s
                stream_idle_timeout: 120s
                route_config:
                  name: r
                  virtual_hosts:
                    - name: r
                      domains: ["*"]
                      routes:
                        # Never reached for /v1/chat/completions: the dynamic module answers
                        # the request itself. Present because a route is required, and it
                        # gives anything else a defined 404 rather than a config error.
                        - match: {prefix: /}
                          direct_response: {status: 404, body: {inline_string: "no route"}}
                http_filters:
                  - name: envoy.filters.http.dynamic_modules
                    typed_config:
                      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.dynamic_modules.v3.DynamicModuleFilter
                      dynamic_module_config: {name: generic_pipeline}
                      filter_name: generic_pipeline
                      # The SAME pipeline document and descriptor set agentgateway loads,
                      # mounted from the same ConfigMap. If these diverged, the two hosts
                      # would be running different orchestrations and the comparison would
                      # measure that instead of the hosting.
                      filter_config:
                        "@type": type.googleapis.com/google.protobuf.StringValue
                        value: |
                          {"pipeline_file":"/etc/dynamo-pipeline/graphs/aggregate.yaml",
                           "grpc_descriptor_file":"/etc/dynamo-pipeline/components_descriptor.bin",
                           "transport_mode":"independent",
                           "grpc_conns":4}
                  - name: envoy.filters.http.router
                    typed_config:
                      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.router.v3.Router
  clusters: []

admin: {address: {socket_address: {address: 0.0.0.0, port_value: 9901}}}
static_resources:
  listeners:
    - name: inference
      address: {socket_address: {address: 0.0.0.0, port_value: 8080}}
      filter_chains:
        - filters:
            - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
              typed_config:
                "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
                stat_prefix: inference
                request_timeout: 120s
                stream_idle_timeout: 120s
                route_config:
                  name: component_pipeline
                  virtual_hosts:
                    - name: component_pipeline
                      domains: ["*"]
                      routes:
                        - match: {prefix: /}
                          direct_response: {status: 404, body: {inline_string: "no route"}}
                http_filters:
                  - name: envoy.filters.http.dynamic_modules
                    typed_config:
                      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.dynamic_modules.v3.DynamicModuleFilter
                      dynamic_module_config: {name: generic_pipeline}
                      filter_name: generic_pipeline
                      filter_config:
                        "@type": type.googleapis.com/google.protobuf.StringValue
                        value: |
                          {"pipeline_file":"/etc/dynamo-pipeline/graphs/aggregate.yaml",
                           "grpc_descriptor_file":"/etc/dynamo-pipeline/components_descriptor.bin",
                           "transport_mode":"envoy_callouts",
                           "upstream_clusters":{"10.0.25.95:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.25.9:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.25.246:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.230:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.24.174:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.24.127:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.73:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.24.15:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.25.126:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.24.5:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.163:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.239:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.74:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.25.86:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.10:50051":"dynamo-worker","10.0.29.16:50051":"dynamo-worker"},
                           "cluster_from_authority":true}
                  - name: envoy.filters.http.router
                    typed_config:
                      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.router.v3.Router
  # Worker clusters may instead arrive through CDS. cluster_from_authority makes
  # a selected endpoint such as http://dynamo-worker:50051 resolve to cluster

  clusters:
    - name: dynamo-preprocessor

      connect_timeout: 2s
      typed_extension_protocol_options:

              initial_connection_window_size: 16777216
              max_concurrent_streams: 4096
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: dynamo-preprocessor
        endpoints:

          explicit_http_config:
            http2_protocol_options:
              initial_stream_window_size: 8388608
              initial_connection_window_size: 16777216
              max_concurrent_streams: 4096
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: dynamo-selector
